steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Component 1 examines Key Films in US and UK cinema, testing your ability to analyse and evaluate film language, representation and context. | Key Fact: Section A focuses on US film, requiring detailed knowledge of your set US film including its production context, genre conventions and representations. | Key Fact: Section B focuses on UK film, requiring understanding of your set UK film including its social context, institutional background and cultural significance. | Key Fact: Both sections include extract-based questions where you analyse a sequence using precise film language terminology and connect techniques to meaning.
